subcategory_text: The integrity of restored assets is verified, systems and services are restored, and normal operating status is confirmed
informative_references: CRI Profile v2.0: RC.RP-05, RC.RP-05.01, RC.RP-05.02
implementation_examples: Check restored assets for indicators of compromise and remediation of root causes of the incident before production use
Verify the correctness and adequacy of the restoration actions taken before putting a restored system online
assessment_objectives: Determine whether the integrity of restored assets is verified, systems and services are restored, and normal operating status is confirmed.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that check restored assets for indicators of compromise and remediation of root causes of the incident before production use.
Determine whether activities are conducted to verify the correctness and adequacy of the restoration actions taken before putting a restored system online.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
